meta.game: Grand Theft Auto VI (released 2026-11-19, PS5 / Xbox Series X|S)
meta.method: Web search only (search-result summaries of the pages listed in each entry's sources).
limitations: Direct page fetching was blocked by this session's network allowlist (www.gtabase.com, www.powerpyx.com, game8.co all refused), so NO page was read in full. Every fact below comes from search-result extracts of the cited pages, not from a full read.

mapgenie.io and ign.com could not be searched at all (both block the search crawler). Rockstar's own site returned nothing usable; the official downloadable Leonida map that PC Gamer says Rockstar posted on 2026-11-19 was NOT opened.

The web-search budget for the session ran out before the following were researched: individual safehouse names, individual garage names/prices, the GamesRadar map-icon guide, and the unique-weapon icon colours follow-up. Those sections are thinner and marked as such.
Rockstar has not published official collectible totals. All totals are from guide sites written in the first five days after launch and several pages are marked WIP.

Fan map sites (gtabase, tracker.gg, gta6-maps.net etc.) report the number of pins they have mapped so far, which is NOT the same as the in-game total. Their counts changed between snapshots within the same site.
meta.where_to_check_in_game: Pause map > Progress > Collections (e.g. Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards; Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations; Progress > Collections > Exploration > Underwater Discoveries / Meditations / Cocaine Flamingos). A category's counter only appears after the first item is found.

global_numbers.progress_database_note: PowerPyx: 'around 3000 collectibles' across vehicles, animals, weapons, collection items, activities, robberies and challenges. PowerPyx estimates the 100% checklist is only about 60% of true completion.
global_numbers.story: Reported as 5 chapters / 91 missions (readdork.com, space4games.com) - not cross-checked against a major guide.

Los Santos sets (individual names NOT retrieved)

collectibles.reward: Trophy 'Don't Touch My Deck' for completing any 3 sets (all sources). Vice City Flamingos set = 'Bubblegum' screen-filter cheat (tilt.app only). No other per-set reward reliably documented (gtadb.net says none documented). Cards can be sold at pawn shops (Vice City Pawn).
collectibles.note: 480 cards / 18 sets / 15 sets for 100% is unanimous. Set sizes: five 36-card sets, one 30-card set (Vice City Club de Futbol), one 18 (Delights Dancers), one 12 (Backyard Wrestling), the rest 24. The arithmetic only reaches 480 if there are ten 24-card sets, i.e. six sets between 'Liberty City' and 'Los Santos' (5x36 + 30 + 10x24 + 18 + 12 = 480) - that split is MY derivation, the six set names were not retrieved. gtabase confirms Vice City Flamingos = 24. Rewards are where sources disagree. Fan-map pin counts for cards (tracker.gg 90, gta6heists.com 100) are mapping progress, not totals. Yellow loot boxes can randomly drop cards (Fextralife).

loot_rarity_colours.summary: No reliable source describes a gold/purple/blue rarity ladder for loot, weapons or vehicles. Do NOT ship rarity colours as a game fact.

weapons.what_guides_describe: Weapon icon colour shows OWNERSHIP, not rarity: owned = light-blue handgun icon (can be modified at Ammu-Nation, recoverable from an owned car trunk or weapon locker); unowned = white icon (cannot be modified, lost when the trunk empties); unique variant = yellow/gold icon (cannot be modified, kept in the weapon locker once either character picks it up).
weapons.outlier: aoeah.com alone claims Common (green) / Rare (blue) / Epic (purple) / Legendary (yellow-gold) inventory tiers. It contradicts the other guides and is unverified.
weapons.terminology: Guides call the gold ones 'unique weapons' / 'unique variants'; Insider Gaming's headline uses 'Legendary weapon variants' informally.

vehicles.what_guides_describe: Two database groups: Base Models (277) and Standout (280), shown in separate tabs. No rarity colour documented. 'Legendary/Epic' labels on one site (egamersworld) and Dexerto's tiers are editorial rankings, not in-game rarity.

collectible_cards.what_guides_describe: Each card comes in one of five editions: Standard, Teal, Pink (Dusty Pink), Gold, Silver. This is the only colour-coded tiering confirmed by a major guide.

containers.what_guides_describe: Randomised world containers are yellow: yellow loot boxes, wall-mounted yellow phone boxes, yellow toolboxes; plus large yellow SCOOP shipping containers (need the Cut-Off Tool). No colour-by-rarity scheme reported.

map_legend.how_to_open: Touchpad (PS5) / View button (Xbox) opens the satellite pause map; D-pad Right slides out the Map Index.
